title: 第226章 问此间（五十四）
content_zh:
“别乌鸦嘴。”刘扶光斥了一句,又觉无奈，眼下大旱肆虐，呼气如焚,搞不好晏欢说的一点没错，“具体情况如何,还是要看过之后再定夺。”
他们穿过漫漫沙漠，刘扶光张开神识，在天穹上四处张望，没见大日的影子，天空却透出一种铁锭烧化之后的晶亮通红，空气中也拥挤着炙热的火毒,凡人若是生活在这里,定然会在几次呼吸后内燃而死。
“水源往往藏在沙漠之下，”晏欢道,“此地的居民,也一定住在地下。”
他们疾驰在沙海当中,不知为何,刘扶光心里总想着黎牧星临行前说过的话,她提到龙的天性,龙的本能……这对他来说，仍是一个无比新奇的议题。一直以来,晏欢身上的至恶属性，压倒性地盖过了他的龙族习性,许多奇怪的表现,都是他和心魔离体之后,才愈来愈多地涌现出来。
譬如晏欢常常自以为隐蔽地嗅着他的味道，和他待在一块的时候，从喉咙到胸膛，全共振出隆隆的呼噜声。还有龙越发严重的筑巢癖好、投喂与囤积的癖好，他狩猎、烹饪，仿佛刘扶光吃得越多，从他这里接受的越多，他便越快活，越舒畅，越心满意足。
甚至每在一处暂作修整，到了要离开的时候，晏欢总要偷偷地变回原型，伸着龙角，袒着腹部，来回在他的枕头和床榻上磨蹭……刘扶光知道，龙腹的细鳞处埋藏着龙的气味腺，那气息烈似海风，带着如同血腥的浓腻香气，直冲得他差点打喷嚏。
若要刘扶光横眉竖目地发一通火，总归也是要离开了；若要他什么都不说，空气里又充满了真龙在求偶期苦熬的渴盼欲念，闻得他手心发痒，好想给晏欢脸皮上来两下……晏欢居然还以为刘扶光发现不了！或者说按照他心理的扭曲程度，就是刘扶光挑明了骂他两句，又能有什么用呢？说不定还给他越骂越高兴了。
好像他们成亲那会，晏欢也没有如此不知廉耻，像头野兽一样四处嗅探、大圈地盘。
是不是至恶的力量剧烈消耗，就像大海退潮之后，才能如此鲜明地显露出沙滩的真正模样？
他尚在沉思，晏欢已停下身形，挑起眉梢，像是发现了什么新奇的玩具一般。
刘扶光抬起头，天时渐晚，狂风在一望无际的旷野上呼啸，犹如万马群嘶。但即便是夜幕降临，也未能替这个世界覆上一层降温的面纱，天空仍然是同样的晶红，只是稍微黯淡了一些。
“非常古老了，”他踩在沙地上，俯身拾起一块不分剑戟，被风沙和高热蚀化到拧起的碎片，“连上面残存的杀意也彻底消逝，你发现了什么？”
晏欢诧异地看了他一眼，想知道爱侣之前在思索些什么，居然这般投入。
刘扶光抬起眼睛，他扔掉了兵器的碎片，有些惭愧地“哦”了一声：“我刚刚……走神了。”
在他面前，黄沙漫天翻卷，但以他目前的眼力，完全可以看见这场大风是如何改变沙漠的地貌：随着飓风的推动，大大小小的沙丘波澜变迁、高低起伏，古战场的面积，也跟着黄沙的潮涌而变化。
“看到了？”晏欢问，“战场的面积可大着呢，说不定整片沙子地，全盖在它上面。”
刘扶光低声道：“这么大的战役，不知道会滋生出多少遗留事端……”
content_en:
"Don't be a bastard." Liu Fuguang scolded him, but felt helpless. The drought was raging and he was breathing heavily. Maybe Yan Huan was right, "We still have to see the specific situation before making a decision."
They passed through the vast desert. Liu Fuguang opened his consciousness and looked around in the sky. He could not see the shadow of the sun, but the sky showed a bright red after burning iron ingots. The air was also crowded with scorching fire poison. If a mortal lived here, he would definitely die of internal combustion after a few breaths.
"Water sources are often hidden under the desert," Yan Huan said. "The residents here must also live underground."
They were galloping in the sea of sand. For some reason, Liu Fuguang always thought about what Li Muxing said before leaving. She mentioned the nature of dragons and their instincts... This was still an extremely novel topic for him. For a long time, Yan Huan's most evil attributes have overwhelmingly outweighed his dragon habits. Many strange manifestations only emerged after he separated from his inner demons.
For example, Yan Huan often thought that he was sniffing his scent secretly, and when she stayed with him, a rumbling purring sound resonated from her throat to her chest. There is also the dragon's increasingly serious habit of building nests, feeding and hoarding. He hunts and cooks. It seems that the more Liu Fuguang eats and the more he receives from him, the happier, more comfortable and more satisfied he becomes.
Even when he was temporarily repairing something, when it was time to leave, Yan Huan would secretly change back to his original shape, stretching out the dragon's horns and exposing his belly, rubbing back and forth on his pillow and bed... Liu Fuguang knew that the fine scales on the dragon's belly contained the dragon's scent glands. The scent was as strong as the sea breeze, with a rich aroma like blood, which made him almost sneeze.
If Liu Fuguang frowned and got angry, he would have to leave after all; if he didn't say anything, the air would be filled with the longing and desire of a true dragon in its courtship period, making his palms itch and wanting to give Yan Huan some shame... Yan Huan actually thought Liu Fuguang couldn't find out! In other words, according to the degree of his psychological distortion, even if Liu Fuguang scolded him clearly, what would be the use? Maybe the more you scold him, the happier he will be.
It seems that when they got married, Yan Huan was not so shameless, sniffing around and encircling the territory like a wild beast.
Is it the violent consumption of the most evil power, just like the receding tide of the sea, that can reveal the true appearance of the beach so clearly?
While he was still deep in thought, Yan Huan stopped and raised his eyebrows, as if he had discovered some novel toy.
Liu Fuguang raised his head. It was getting late, and the strong wind was howling in the endless wilderness, like a herd of horses neighing. But even as night falls, it fails to cover the world with a cooling veil. The sky is still the same crystal red, but slightly darker.
"It's very old." He stepped on the sand and leaned over to pick up a fragment of a sword and halberd that had been corroded by the wind and high heat. "Even the remaining murderous intent on it has completely disappeared. What did you find?"
Yan Huan glanced at him in surprise, wondering what his lover was thinking about before and why he was so involved.
Liu Fuguang raised his eyes, threw away the fragments of the weapon, and said "Oh" with some shame: "I just... got distracted."
In front of him, the yellow sand rolled all over the sky, but with his current eyesight, he could completely see how the strong wind changed the desert landscape: with the push of the hurricane, the large and small sand dunes changed, rising and falling, and the area of the ancient battlefield also changed with the tide of yellow sand.
"Did you see it?" Yan Huan asked, "The battlefield is quite large. Maybe the entire sandy field is covered on it."
Liu Fuguang whispered: "Such a big battle, I don't know how many remaining troubles it will breed..."
